status: RATIFIED as built on 2026-11-02 (five-section thank-you structure; see structure_approval). The owner supplied no precise thank-you layout (82-signature-thank-you/references/layout-and-copy-profiles.md, preamble). This spec merges the two structures already in the repo: Skill 82's order of parts (header, order summary, access blocks, what happens next, support and manage) and Skill 49's TY bands (a welcome, 4 to 6 numbered next steps, a signed close of up to 170 characters, no offer button, exactly one celebration hero image). It is the page type's canonical section sequence for the Skill 71 pipeline, in the same shape as the landing specs, so the section-count check, the request builder, the wireframe prompt and the copy validator read it through scripts/page_role.py and never fork the pipeline. Change this file, not the code, when Trevor changes the layout.

structure_approval.basis: Decision taken as recommended on 2026-11-02 (repair project bfl-s49-repair-20261102, decision STR-17): ratify as built, because the structure already matches Skill 49 page_types, Skill 71 copy specs and funnel_structure.json. A later change to its sections is a new decision with its own date.

later_decisions.basis: A new dated decision under the rule above, not a change to the ratified five-section sequence. Section 2 is one summary card holding only the copy's approved item line and payment line (no table, column headers, status chips, grey bars or totals). Section 3 draws one card per item the copy names. Section 5 draws a filled support button, an outlined button with the copy's own label and a signature line, with no grey bar.

guide.note: Skill 82 owns the page's truth (purchase records, access, billing). This spec owns its section sequence and picture layout for the wireframe and mockup stages. The copy for the page comes from Skill 82's clean copy profiles; it is never invented here.

counting_convention.char_counting: Join the visible components with one space; count letters, punctuation, and spaces.
counting_convention.word_tokenization: Strip markers, normalize whitespace, count whitespace-separated tokens.
counting_convention.source: Same convention as the landing specs (standard-v6.json counting_convention).

rules.primary_button: the access button, filled in the client's primary brand colour
rules.no_pitch: The page sells nothing: no new offer, no price for anything not purchased, no 'one more thing' (82-signature-thank-you/references/no-pitch-policy.md).
rules.source: Skill 49 structure/funnel_structure.json (thank_you, image_coverage.page_policies.thank-you: one celebratory hero, image maximum of one; profiles.thank-you: no offer CTAs); Skill 82 no-pitch policy.

markers.button: [CTA BUTTON: <access, download, support or manage label>]

cta_map.note: Utility buttons only (access, download, schedule, manage purchase, support). Never an offer button. Section 3 shows one card as the pattern and repeats once per purchased item.

sections.name: Confirmation and welcome
sections.job: Celebrate the decision and confirm the order honestly: a status label and headline, one reassurance line, the primary access button and the order reference, beside the page's one celebration image.

cta.note: The primary access button ('Start here'); absent only when no access is granted yet.

limits.source: Skill 49 TY-1 band (120 to 180 characters), applied as a suggestion because the headline states the real order status

default_slots.art_direction: warm celebration of the decision, a confident moment for the buyer, never a product pitch

layout.desktop: Hero ground band inside the 1200 px content column. The text block, top to bottom: a status label chip, the page headline (H1) stating the order status honestly, one reassurance line, the primary access button (filled, primary brand colour) and under it the order reference in small tracked capitals. The page's one celebration image plate is composed with the treatment the composition contract names for the slot; whatever that treatment, the text block keeps this order and the button stays filled in the primary colour.
layout.mobile: Single-column phone stack: the text block in the same order (status label chip, headline, reassurance line, primary access button, order reference), with the celebration image plate placed where the composition contract places it; the primary access button spans the full content column.

sections.note: Primary access button sits under the headline and reassurance line; order reference is text, never a button

sections.name: Order summary
sections.job: Summarise the purchase from the approved copy only: one summary card that holds the copy's approved item line and the copy's approved payment line as readable text.

layout.desktop: Light ground band. A section heading, then ONE summary card inside the 1200 px content column. The card holds only the copy's approved item line and the copy's approved payment line, set as readable text. No table, no column headers, no status chips, no grey bars, no totals, no image and no button. Nothing the copy does not supply is drawn: never an item name, a figure or a currency sign that the approved copy does not carry.
layout.mobile: Light ground band. ONE summary card at full width, holding only the copy's approved item line and the copy's approved payment line as readable text. No table, no column headers, no status chips, no grey bars, no totals, no image and no button. Nothing the copy does not supply is drawn: never an item name, a figure or a currency sign that the approved copy does not carry.

sections.note: Summary from the approved copy only

sections.name: Access
sections.job: Give one access card per purchased item: its name, what it unlocks, and one utility button that goes to it.

cta.note: One access, download or schedule button per card; the manuscript shows one card as the pattern.

layout.desktop: Dark ground band. A section heading, then a row of access cards across the 1200 px column, one card per item the copy names. Each card: an icon at the top from the brand's icon style, the item name from the copy, one line saying what it unlocks, and one filled utility button carrying the copy's own label. No photograph. Draw only the cards the copy names: no placeholder card, no grey bar and no invented product, bonus or membership.
layout.mobile: Dark ground band. The cards stack one per row at full width, one card per item the copy names, each with its icon, item name, one-line description and a full-width utility button carrying the copy's own label. No photograph. Draw only the cards the copy names: no placeholder card, no grey bar and no invented product, bonus or membership.

sections.note: One card per item the copy names; no card for a pending or failed item

sections.name: What happens next
sections.job: Say in four to six numbered steps what happens now and next, momentum-ordered, each step starting with a verb and naming its payoff.

step_count.source: Skill 49 TY-2 (4 to 6 numbered steps; each step 89 to 116 characters, applied by the reviewer: per-step character bands are defined for a seven-step page only)

layout.desktop: Light ground band. A section heading, then the numbered steps inside the 1200 px column, drawn in the client's design style: Style A (Block) runs them as full-width numbered rows, one step per row, a primary-colour square-cornered number block at the left of each row and a hairline rule between rows; Style B (Circle) and Style C (Hybrid) set them in one horizontal row of primary-colour circle badges joined by a dotted line, with the verb-led step label under each. No button and no image.
layout.mobile: Light ground band. The steps stack in one column at full width, each number badge beside its step label: square-cornered number blocks with hairline rules between rows for Style A, primary-colour circle badges on a dotted line down the left for Style B and Style C. No button and no image.

sections.note: Four to six steps; badges read 1 to N once each, in order; no button here

sections.name: Help, manage and close
sections.job: Close the page: how to get help with this order, how to manage the purchase, and a short signed note of thanks of up to 170 characters. No offer button.

cta.note: One filled support button; the manage-purchase action is a secondary outlined button, never a second filled button.

limits.source: Skill 49 TY-3 (the signed close is up to 170 characters); the section also carries the support lines, so the cap is descriptive for the whole section

layout.desktop: Hero ground band, two columns inside the 1200 px content column. Left: the support heading, one line on how to reach help, the filled support button and beside it an outlined button carrying the copy's own label (for example 'Open my access page'). Right: the short signed note of thanks and the signature line, set in script. No offer button and no price. No grey bar is drawn anywhere in this section, and no behaviour note names an element that is not drawn.
layout.mobile: Single-column phone stack: the signed note and its signature line in script first, then the support heading and line, the filled support button at full width and the outlined button carrying the copy's own label at full width under it. No offer button and no price. No grey bar is drawn anywhere in this section, and no behaviour note names an element that is not drawn.

sections.note: Support is the primary action here; the outlined button carries the copy's own label and is secondary; no offer button

desktop-wireframe.label: Standard Desktop (sheet grammar only for the thank-you page)

mobile-tablet.label: Long-Form Mobile (single-column phone stack; sheet grammar only for the thank-you page)

wireframe.reference_note: The attached reference is a landing page sheet. For this page it gives the sheet grammar only: section chips with name tabs, printed type specs, labelled image plates, filled CTA chips and contiguous bands. Its sections, section count, words and layout are never copied.
wireframe.desktop_block: THANK-YOU DESKTOP — a five-section confirmation page, not a landing page. The sections are Confirmation and welcome, Order summary, Access, What happens next, Help manage and close, in that order, on alternating grounds with hard butt joins. The page carries exactly one image plate in total (in the first section). No section is an offer, a pitch or a persuasion band, and no filled button is an offer button. Never merge two numbered sections into one band.
wireframe.steps_block: STEPS — between four and six numbered steps, 1 up to the last step once each in that order, each beside its own step label from the copy, drawn in the client's design style (the DESIGN STYLE line governs the badge: square-cornered blocks in full-width rows for Style A, circles on a dotted line for Style B and C). Never a seventh step that the copy does not carry.
wireframe.do_not_copy: DO NOT COPY THE EXAMPLE'S MISTAKES — the style reference was drawn by a model for a landing page and carries flaws. Never reproduce: a misspelt label (DESKTOR for DESKTOP, BTEP for STEP, featofe, thwo); a section number printed twice or skipped; garbled badges; an invalid ratio such as 3:9; duplicated text; placeholder words such as lorem ipsum or GOES HERE; any landing-page section, pain band, benefit grid or founder letter that this page's copy does not carry.
